# protonpass_password (Ephemeral Resource)

Password ephemeral resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "protonpass_password" "example" {
  length    = 50
  numbers   = true
  uppercase = true
  symbols   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `length` (Number) Amount of characters in the password
- `numbers` (Boolean) Whether to include numbers in the generated password
- `symbols` (Boolean) Whether to include symbols in the generated password
- `uppercase` (Boolean) Whether to include uppercase characters in the generated password

### Read-Only

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Generated password
